research_target: A recurrent picture state that carries event history through the frozen VLM image interface.
diagnostic_question: After source anchoring and equal-unit aggregation both fail, does forcing the pre-AdamW aggregate to be a common first-order descent direction for all eight current micro-segments restore hard8 learnability?

single_changed_variable.name: micro_segment_gradient_aggregation
single_changed_variable.common-descent-projected-norm-matched: d=argmin_v 0.5*||v-g_raw||^2 subject to dot(g_i,v)>=0 for i=1..8; g_applied=d*||g_raw||/||d||
single_changed_variable.common_execution: Both arms compute all eight per-segment gradients independently in the same deterministic order.
single_changed_variable.solver: Normalize each constraint by ||g_i||, enumerate all 2^8 active sets in ascending bitmask order, solve each KKT system in float64 on CPU, choose minimum projection distance and smallest-mask tie break.
single_changed_variable.magnitude_control: The projected direction is positively rescaled to the raw-mean L2 norm before the unchanged global clip=10 operation.
single_changed_variable.scope_caveat: The common-descent inequality is exact in pre-AdamW gradient geometry; Adam moments, diagonal preconditioning, weight decay, and finite step size can change the realized parameter-update geometry.
fail_closed: every micro-gradient is finite and nonzero
the raw and projected aggregates are finite and nonzero
a numerically feasible active set exists
the projection does not collapse to zero
every projected micro cosine is at least -1e-5
relative norm-match error is at most 1e-5
at least one raw step violates a micro constraint and at least one projected step changes direction

fixed_contract.dataset: formal-v1 fixed train/dev files and R5 deterministic split
fixed_contract.train_subset: the exact R6/R7 hard8: two deterministic segments from each of F2/F3/F5/F6
fixed_contract.updater: DreamLite-mobile U-Net LoRA rank 4; base frozen
fixed_contract.learning_rate_schedule: R5 640-step schedule prefix: 16-step 1e-5 to 3e-5 warmup then cosine toward 1e-5

paired_diagnostics: per-step raw versus applied gradient cosine and norm-match error
per-step raw and projected minimum micro cosine, violating-micro count, active set, and projection distance
per-step micro-gradient norm ratio and negative pairwise cosine fraction
hard8 train endpoint versus arm-specific M0
fixed formal-select-32 and mechanism-select-32 endpoint versus arm-specific M0
normal/reset difference-in-differences from M0 to endpoint
cross-episode and temporal state swaps on hard8

interpretation_rules.projected_pass_raw_fail: Support destructive batch directions as a primary local bottleneck; advance source anchoring plus common-descent projection to the unchanged fixed full-data pilot.
interpretation_rules.both_fail: Reject batch conflict as a sufficient explanation; run an eight-segment individual-learnability decomposition on the identical transitions before changing rank, data volume, Reader, or loss.
interpretation_rules.both_pass: Conflict projection is not necessary for local learnability; fixed-dev evidence and simplicity select the advancing law.
interpretation_rules.raw_pass_projected_fail: Reject common-descent projection and retain raw aggregation.
interpretation_rules.projected_technical_fail: Make no scientific decision; repair projection feasibility or implementation and rerun in a fresh root.

formal_success_still_requires: normal better than reset and state swaps
endpoint improvement over its own M0 with paired uncertainty
